facts.note: Transcript gives the nine o'clock temple strike, a watch reading of twenty minutes to nine, and the uncle's scene about it.
Transcript has him alone in the library after dinner, and at the temple's ten, his watch reads twenty to ten.
Transcript gives the thump in the atelier at eighteen minutes past ten by his watch, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones he stopped counting.

Transcript has someone going quickly up past the library door at a quarter past ten by his watch, unseen, door shut, and someone coming quickly down at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch, also unseen.
Transcript says the aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came. The Chopin identification is extra colour, not a contradiction.
Transcript has Girard entering the library at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch and the two sitting together until the temple struck eleven.
